title: Zen Minimalist Living Room with Bamboo and Floor Cushions
description: A calming, minimalist living room inspired by Japanese Zen principles. Features include bamboo wall panels, a low wooden table, and floor cushions. Neutral colors, open spaces, and potted bonsai trees create a peaceful, meditative atmosphere.

title: Retro 70s Living Room with Vibrant Colors and Geometric Patterns
description: A funky, retro-inspired living room that brings back the 1970s with bold colors, geometric patterns, and vintage furniture. Orange and mustard hues dominate the color scheme, with shag carpets, velvet couches, and psychedelic artwork creating a nostalgic atmosphere.

title: Country Cottage Living Room with Rustic Wood and Floral Prints
description: This cozy, country-inspired cottage living room is filled with rustic wooden furniture, floral-printed fabrics, and soft pastel colors. A stone fireplace, plush armchairs, and lace curtains add to the quaint, homey feel of the space.

title: Modern Glam with Marble Accents and Gold Detailing
description: A luxurious modern glam living room with marble accents, gold detailing, and plush furniture. The space is filled with mirrored surfaces, velvet seating, and a statement chandelier, offering an opulent and refined aesthetic.

title: Forest-Inspired Woodland Retreat with Moss Green and Natural Stone
description: A forest-inspired living room with moss green walls, natural stone accents, and rustic wood furniture. Fern plants, large windows, and earthy textures make this space feel like a woodland retreat right at home.

title: Art Deco Revival with Bold Lines and Luxurious Finishes
description: A glamorous art deco-inspired living room with bold geometric lines, glossy finishes, and luxurious fabrics. Deep jewel tones, metallic accents, and vintage-style lighting evoke the glitz and elegance of the Roaring Twenties.

title: Rustic Farmhouse with Exposed Beams and Vintage Finds
description: A rustic farmhouse-style living room with exposed wooden beams, vintage decor, and cozy textiles. Featuring distressed wood furniture, antique knick-knacks, and warm lighting, this space exudes rural charm and a welcoming ambiance.

title: Contemporary Mediterranean with White Walls and Terracotta Accents
description: A breezy Mediterranean-inspired living room with white stucco walls, terracotta tile flooring, and simple, elegant furniture. The room is accented with olive green plants, clay pottery, and woven baskets, bringing a relaxed, coastal vibe.

title: Eclectic Maximalist with Color Pops and Bold Prints
description: A vibrant eclectic maximalist living room filled with bold prints, color pops, and unique decor. The space includes mismatched furniture, statement art pieces, and layers of textures, creating a lively and artistic environment.

title: Hollywood Regency with Velvet Sofas and Gold-Trimmed Decor
description: A Hollywood Regency-inspired living room featuring plush velvet sofas, gold-trimmed mirrors, and luxurious decor. Rich jewel tones, ornate chandeliers, and lacquered furniture give this room a glamorous, vintage Hollywood feel.
